Name: Help Wanted Quest Fixes
Author: Pokeytax
Description:
[center]﻿[b][size=6]"Help Wanted" Quest Fixes[/size][/b][/center]
Are you tired of killing slimes for Mayor Lewis? Do you think you might scream if you have to collect [i]one more [/i]copper ore for Clint? This mod unlocks hidden game code allowing for a greater variety of quests, and includes the ability to configure the types you want to see.

Full list of possible quests (including those previously hidden):

[list]
[*][b]Item Delivery[/b] (Every villager: crops, forageables, fish, minerals, metal bars)
[*][b]Gathering [/b](Clint: copper, iron, gold, coal; Robin: wood, stone)
[*][b]Fishing [/b](Willy, Demetrius)
[*][b]Slay Monsters [/b](Lewis, Demetrius, Wizard)
[list]
[*]Mines 1-39: Green Slime, Rock Crab, Duggy
[*]Mines 40-79: Frost Jelly, Skeleton, Dust Spirit
[*]Mines 80+: Sludge, Ghost, Lava Crab, Squid Kid
[/list][/list]
All items should be obtainable within the current season, where applicable.

[size=5]Install[/size]

[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*](optional) Run the game once with SMAPI to generate the config file, then configure desired options in Stardew Valley/Mods/HelpWantedQuestFixes/config.json.

[*]Play the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]How to use[/size]

The generated config file has several options for use.
[list]
[*][b]AllowShallowMineQuests [/b](default: "true"): Allows Slay Monsters quests from all levels of the mine, not just your deepest depth reached.

[/list][list]
[*][b]ChanceOfQuestPerDay [/b](default: "65"): The percentage chance a quest will be offered on any given day. Default value taken from the game code.
[*][b]CategoryChancePercent[/b]: The percentage chance for availability of each quest type (adding up to 100 total). Default values are taken from the game code.
[list]
[*]ItemDelivery (default "62")
[*]Gathering (default "11")
[*]Fishing (default "15")
[*]Slay Monsters (default "12")
[/list][/list][size=5]
Compatibility[/size]

Works with Stardew Valley 1.3. Not tested in multiplayer, but it likely needs to be installed for the host as well as each farmhand who wants to use it.

Downloads.Description: Place in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder to install. Requires SDV 1.3+ and SMAPI v.2.9+.
